answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock. Each agent locks 40 POA; the network records its fingerprint — timing, tool mix, counterparties — unique as marble grain. A random audit demands a match, verified by a saffron-priced check. One forged fingerprint costs 25 POA plus a 40 POA bond locked 20 epochs, so 100 fakes lock 6500 POA against a 400 POA pool. Like timber, only real beams hold: the honest agent pays once and reclaims its bond with interest.
